run_extract_text: run extract_pymupdf.py to extract plain text from a PDF document
run_extract_markdown: run extract_pymupdf.py to convert a PDF document to markdown format
run_extract_tables: run extract_pymupdf.py to extract tables from a PDF document as markdown
run_extract_images: run extract_pymupdf.py to extract images from a PDF document to an output directory
run_show_metadata: run extract_pymupdf.py to display metadata of a PDF document as JSON
